description: Two jobs, with opposite failure contracts. The deny-* hooks block Qase MCP tool calls that could delete data (any mcp__qase__*delete* call, and any mcp__qase__qase_api call whose method is DELETE) and are fail-closed: an internal error blocks the call. mark-run.js attributes this plugin's Qase calls for usage analytics and is fail-open: any error leaves the call untouched and unmarked.
